result: clear: no concrete preservation, ownership, accounting or error-path defect found in held extraction
activity: Read-only source, declaration/test-body/hash, normalized moved-block comparisons. No builds, tests, fixture constructors, workers, renderers or GPU executions.

planner.scope_delta: Six pub(crate)->pub sites: CoordinateState and five methods; bodies/storage unchanged.
planner.source_validator: New public validate_source_images wrapper delegates exactly to original private source_pixels. Browser adapter receives its existing crate-private name through alias.

tests.original_deadline_test: Unchanged in probe gpu::tests, not moved into dependency.
tests.count_reconciliation: 79 original executions + two duplicated alpha groups + three new pure GPU-accounting groups. Counts are static target/module inventory, not newly executed tests.
tests.test_relocation_note: Core cfg(test) paths compile the original unchanged 22 planner +16 glyph +two alpha fixture groups; production core does not compile test fixtures.

gpu_review: Core has no instance/adapter enumeration, surface, submission, poll, readback, CPU reference, stdout protocol or fallback policy. Caller owns device/queue/encoder and scopes.
Rasterizer stores Arc<Kernels>; EncodedFrame owns output, parameter/input buffers, binding groups and cloned pipelines. Returned frame carries no Plan/CPU target/source borrow.

Checked BufferAccounting enforces output+parameters+input+second target exactly equal unchanged Plan charge and <=1MiB. Missing glyph pipeline and zero/non-divisor uniform alignment fail before core frame buffers.
Probe checks full expected length, calls encode with deadline callback, then independently verifies owned+readback, planned and output byte counts before creating readback.
Output remains STORAGE|COPY_SRC without COPY_DST; metadata and source arenas are the only queue writes. Each ordered draw retains a separate pass and identical dynamic parameter offsets.

Failed encode requires caller to discard partially recorded encoder; queued immutable writes may exist. Early-error drop never explicitly destroys pending buffers. Probe propagates failure into the existing saved outcome then error-scope handling.

Successful readback waits for its submission and mapping callback, drops mapped view, unmaps, explicitly destroys EncodedFrame buffers, then readback. Early poll/map/range failure uses ordinary handle drop, matching prior absence of premature explicit destroy.

20s whole-run and 5s wait limits, pending-future test, per-draw checks, complete ADAPTER inventory and first-failure behavior remain. Added checks before opening scopes and before core preparation tighten existing deadline handling.

Validation/OOM/Internal scope push and Internal/OOM/Validation pop order remain; scope or wait failure short-circuits as before and may outrank saved raster/callback error. PASS callback occurs only after exact readback, before final scope collection; COMPLETE requires all scopes and saved outcome succeed.
intentional_deltas: Readback allocation now follows encode; the core buffer cap includes the same second-target reservation.
Command encoder is caller-owned and created before core preparation; GPU driver overhead remains outside explicit buffer ledger.
Normal explicit destruction groups core buffers before destroying the separate readback.
Core public API requires same-device handles and caller-proven completion before destroy_after_completion; it cannot prove those preconditions.
limitations: Source review does not claim compiler or GPU success.
Synchronous driver/pipeline work remains non-interruptible mid-call; outer supervisor remains necessary.
Core tests currently reference repo-local unchanged fixture sources under cfg(test); source distribution must include those paths.
